The pairing_geometry gate passed with scene-level grouping, nested observations, disjoint data roles, and no pairing backfill.
The geometry_contract gate passed for the frozen whole-image-before-crop and bounded crop rules; edge/interior evidence remains descriptive only.
The null_control_validity gate passed for the scope of this compact review.
The precision_feasibility requirement was met under the frozen planning-SD upper bound and stratum capacity contract.
The review_contract_resolution outcome was favorable only for authoring a revised S1 utility-qualification contract.

limitations: This route used archived development-screening compact evidence only and performed no new scientific metric computation, inference, or training.
The archived parent terminal remains COMPLETED_INCONCLUSIVE with authorization limited to S1 review work.
The ITS shifted-target null still lacks a frozen diagnostic that separates measurement invalidity from a genuine target-construction response.
